content.text:
Restart note: you reloaded every window on 2026-10-12 13:36 AWST, so test whether the status bar follows the focused Claude tab when you switch sessions in the same workspace.

**Walk-in offer (5 sentences, in person):**

1. "Hi, I'm Macdara, I build websites for local gyms, and I looked at yours before walking in."
2. "Three things on your current site are costing you sign-ups: [defect 1, e.g. the trial button sits below the fold on mobile], [defect 2], [defect 3]."
3. "Squarespace limits how far those can be fixed, so I'd build you a new custom site rather than patch this one."
4. "I've already made a demo of what yours would look like, and I can show you on my phone right now."
5. "If you like it, I host and look after it too, so you never touch a plugin or a template again; can I show you the demo?"

**Notes:**
- The brief says we don't polish a builder site in place (the 2026-09-18 ruling), so sentence 3 pitches a rebuild, not a nicer-looking Squarespace.
- Sentence 2 needs three real defects from `docs/playbooks/squarespace-polish.md`, found on their actual site. I haven't invented any.
- I left out price, per your no-unasked-billing rule.
- Sentence 4 assumes you built the demo first via `/prospect-to-pitch`. If you haven't, drop it and end on "can I send you a mockup of your own gym?"
